outer_diameter = 38.4
inner_diameter = 21.3
length = 58.7
boss_diameter = 45.3
boss_length = 21.3
chamfer_size = 2.0

boss_radius = boss_diameter / 2.0

boss = Pos(length + boss_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_length)

hole = Pos((length + boss_length)/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius, length + boss_length + 10)
result = result - hole

part = result
part.name = "cylindrical_part_with_boss"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

length = 79.9
width = 34.3
thickness = 7.4
fillet_radius = 2.9
window_width = 30.0
window_height = 18.8
window_depth = 1.4
hole_diameter = 3.4
hole_spacing = 6.4
hole_rows = 2
hole_cols = 2
cross_arm_width = 2.9
cross_arm_length = 10.0
cross_depth = 1.4

solid_body = Box(length, thickness, width)
bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
solid_body = fillet(bottom_face.edges(), fillet_radius)

window = Pos(0, thickness/2 - window_depth/2, 0) * Box(window_width, window_depth, window_height)
solid_body = solid_body - window

for i in range(hole_cols):
    for j in range(hole_rows):
        x = -length/4 + (i - (hole_cols-1)/2) * hole_spacing
        z = (j - (hole_rows-1)/2) * hole_spacing
        hole = Pos(x, 0, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, thickness + 1)
        solid_body = solid_body - hole

cross_x = length/2 - cross_arm_length/2 - 5
cross_cut1 = Pos(cross_x, thickness/2 - cross_depth/2, 0) * Box(cross_arm_length, cross_depth, cross_arm_width)
cross_cut2 = Pos(cross_x, thickness/2 - cross_depth/2, 0) * Box(cross_arm_width, cross_depth, cross_arm_length)
solid_body = solid_body - cross_cut1 - cross_cut2

part = solid_body
part.name = "plate_with_window_holes_and_cross"
export_step(part, "output.step")

base_width = 58.8
base_length = 80.0
